findings.controls: Extend CAPTURE_CACHED_APPLICATION_REFUSED with a cached genuine updater and each declared helper carrying the expected canonical name/origin but different code; its current undeclared dummy does not cover this case. Keep circular/fromlist/dataclass/resource positives.
findings.evidence: catalog.bootstrap includes friday_genuine_updater and all five applications. native_capture validates only cached name/origin; it does not reject cached applications, compare loaded code to capture bytes, evict them, or force a fresh loader. native_module uses importlib.import_module, which can return an already cached declared application instead of captured bytes. sys.meta_path cannot intercept that cached return.
findings.impact: The genuine entry/helpers and original staged payload may come from stale reopened bootstrap code; the advertised same-read capture is not enforced for the application route.
findings.required_change: Keep a separately reviewed trusted initial interpreter bootstrap boundary and reject or safely restore/replace all cached application modules and their references before using captured applications. Bind the genuine entry and helpers to captured execution, not origin strings.

findings.controls: Add a first-caller bootstrap birth/thread before GO and a host-side captured native-import birth/thread. Check actual inherited controller identity/limits and closure from the first effect. Existing CHILD_SCOPE_DRIFT, TASKS_NOT_PROCESSES and SPAWN_RESERVATION_EXHAUSTED must remain and do not cover the post-Popen migration gap.
findings.evidence: native_host creates an empty private sibling group and its hard controllers, then Popen starts the first native caller in the host inherited group; only after Popen/pidfd/birth returns does it write the child PID to the new cgroup. The initial Python interpreter/bootstrap runs before that migration and before GO. Later the host imports captured genuine updater/third-party native extensions while still outside the native child group. There is no exact hard ancestor reservation check covering these opaque tasks/descendants in the reviewed procedure.
findings.impact: Before-GO migration does not provide inherited hard whole memory/swap/pids/CPU coverage before every birth. Existing per-process AS/CPU caps do not substitute for whole inherited task/thread/swap bounds. Child group empty/host main-thread children empty cannot prove custody for unreserved opaque bootstrap/host extension work.
findings.required_change: Integrate a concrete externally admitted existing-owner first-birth/host-bootstrap reservation and confinement before interpreter/native effects, keeping protected shared scope untouched; include opaque host import work and every descendant/thread in the declared whole ledger and fresh closure. Do not introduce a new general supervisor/controller.
